title: Strict JSON compliance testbed and decoder fallback scenarios
creator: Anjali Rao
description: Build a focused testbed that validates strict JSON payload compliance across streaming, tool-calls, and fallback paths. This ticket covers: (1) a test matrix exercising strict JSON production under high token-churn and partial-stream scenarios; (2) constrained-decoding gating behavior (beam/temperature/clamp combos) against schema-attestation detectors; (3) end-to-end pass/fail criteria for automatic fallback policies (variant models, relaxed-schema paths, and tool-call sanitizers). The goal is to catch regressions in production where the model emits non-JSON tokens, truncated objects, or ambiguous escapes that break downstream parser and tool integrations. This differs from prior fuzz/regression suites by focusing on orchestrated multi-path flows (stream -> tool-call -> resume -> finalization) and asserting both syntactic and semantic conformance to schemas defined in the test harness. Success criteria are reliable detection of non-conforming outputs, clear reproducible failure cases, and a deterministic remediation plan (fallback rule or retry policy) that reduces customer-visible failures by >=90% on the sampled traffic spike simulations.
plan: Instrument existing stream harness to capture partial-chunk boundaries and KV cache triggers
Add schema-attestation module that runs in parallel to constrained-decoder (no blocking) to surface false-positive rates
Create 24 test scenarios combining: (a) streaming/complete outputs, (b) function/tool-call in-stream return, (c) mid-stream truncation, (d) injected token noise
Implement a synthetic traffic generator that simulates concurrent users with varied sequence length distributions
Run tests against three model variants (float16 baseline, 8-bit quantized, and safety-trim variant) and record failure modes
Define deterministic fallback flows: retry with constrained decoding, switch to relaxed-schema path, or invoke tool-call sanitizer depending on failure signature
Ship test artifacts and integrate as a nightly regression job; add alerts for flakiness > 2% on stable builds
acceptance_criteria: Nightly job executes all 24 scenarios and produces pass/fail report in < 90 minutes
For sampled production-like traffic, the fallback strategy reduces parser failures (non-JSON or truncated JSON) by >=90% in the lab
False-positive rate for schema-attestation module < 1% on held-out golden prompts
Well-documented runbook linking failure signatures to remediation actions (retry parameters, model variant mapping, sanitizer rules)
PRs for harness changes, attestation module, and new regression job merged and code-reviewed by runtime and infra teams
